summary: Every Firecrawl API request carries X-Integration: _printing_press so Firecrawl can tell requests from this CLI apart from other clients.
reason: Firecrawl reads the integration from the request body or the X-Integration header; values outside its built-in list must start with an underscore. The CLI's User-Agent starts with firecrawl, which Firecrawl does not use for attribution, so without the header its requests are indistinguishable from direct API use.
validated_outcome: go build, go vet and go test pass from the CLI root; the header is set next to the User-Agent on every request the shared client sends.
